statement: cos(4) = 1 mod 16 in Z_2 (line 1 of the manuscript's table).
argument: The manuscript's value. At a prime the setting prec is the absolute p-adic precision N (tools/adf/README.md:249-251), so "cos(4) = 1 mod 16" is the line `2: 1 + O(2^4)` at prec 4. The series of cos converges on 4 Z_2 (tools/adf/README.md:468-469). docs/SPEC.md:587 records the checked vector cos 4 = 9 mod 16, so the manuscript's line is expected to fail.
